prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished high fidelity desktop WEBSITE SCREENSHOT mockup for the existing Hebrew RTL Geo9900 military geography education site. This is one of two design alternatives to the exercise "תרגול: סיווג מרכיבי השטח". Not a poster, not a presentation, no device mockup, no perspective on the screen itself. Render a complete flat UI design frame approximately 1440 x1122, landscape 1.283 aspect ratio. Crisp native-looking readable Hebrew typesetting, Rubik bold headings and Heebo body. Body must be generous 16px apparent size. All substantive lesson text black. Olive #38432E for site chrome, cream #F3E9DC canvas, white #FFFFFF workspace, subtle tan #DCCDB2 borders, 16px radii, warm soft shadows. Sage #5B7C5C only correctness state. Orange #D97E2B / #E08A38 only action and selected focus. No rainbow categories, no blue, purple or neon, no dark futuristic dashboard. Faint low contrast contour texture in page margins only.
Preserve recognizable existing site chrome: white horizontal 80px header; right-aligned compass rose and "גיאוגרפיה צבאית"; quiet navigation across upper center-left "בית", "תכנית הלימודים", "פרוטוטייפים", "תרגול חוזר", "ארכיון". Far RIGHT sidebar 240px wide, white, below header; orange "שיעור 2", olive "קרטוגרפיה", separator, "תוכן השיעור"; rows "פתיחה", "לפני שמתחילים", selected cream rounded row "תבליט ותכסית", "תבניות נוף", "תכסית", "טופוגרפיה", "קנה מידה", "קואורדינטות 1", "קואורדינטות 2", "קווי גובה", "משמעות מעשית", "סיכום". Bottom compact orange progress rule and "לימוד", "תרגול", "בדיקת ידע". This sidebar is supporting chrome, never competes with exercise. Main content is x64 through x1116, width1052, leaving64px gap before sidebar. Entire exercise comfortably fits under header with no clipping. Scene H2 top right "תרגול: סיווג מרכיבי השטח" black32px; short instruction line beneath. Use one strong central visual hierarchy; no blank wasted half-screen. No labels naming the concept number, no design annotations. Two options only: "תבליט" and "תכסית". The unchanged eight items, in RTL right-to-left order, are "גבעה", "חורש", "בית", "עמק", "כביש", "מדרון", "מטע זיתים", "אוכף". Hill, valley, slope, saddle are relief; grove, house, road, cultivated olive orchard are land cover. Never imply orchard natural just because trees are natural. Visuals: geographically plausible Mediterranean limestone hills, olive-green vegetation, tan earth. Restrained realistic rendered terrain illustrations with photographic detail and soft daylight, NOT blocky low-poly, NOT stacked papercut. Accessible clear label contrast. No soldiers, vehicles, weapons or combat. All Hebrew exactly spelled. Header and sidebar are RTL; geographic landscape not mirrored for RTL.
ALTERNATIVE A: "כרטיס שטח מצולם". Layout draws on the archive's large photographic category cards and single-current-item interaction, in a sophisticated generous educational workspace. Show the third item HOUSE before answering. Main intro exact "התבוננו ברכיב המסומן ובחרו את הסיווג המתאים." In white rounded exercise workspace, top quiet counter at left "סווגו 2 מתוך 8", at right modest label "תבליט או תכסית?". Large center hero splits: RIGHT approx620px width, LEFT approx350px width. RIGHT: a very large beautiful image approx600x345px of one small stone house with terra cotta roof in a Mediterranean hilly landscape, thin orange focus outline around the HOUSE ONLY and subtle leader to a white label "בית". Background hills recede softly. This is image-based recognition of a specific object, not classification of entire scene. Small pill in image corner "רכיב 3 מתוך 8". LEFT: black bold question "לאיזו שכבה שייך הבית?" and two stacked substantial category CHOICE CARDS, each containing an image header band 105px tall. First choice "תבליט" with bare rolling hills and contours in the image; second "תכסית" with shrubs, trees, houses and a small road in the image. Both white neutral borders, neither selected, no green correctness yet. The category labels are below the imagery and explicitly black. No explanatory category definitions to give away the answer. A brief neutral helper "בחרו באחד הכרטיסים" below. No redundant submit if card click submits. Bottom inside main workspace a clean fullwidth rail of EIGHT small thumbnail cards approx108x86 each, every one image+exact item label. Reading right-to-left first "גבעה" then "חורש" with small sage checks, third "בית" outlined orange (active), remaining5 pending tan borders. Each thumbnail is distinctive and consistent. Directly under rail a slim 8segment progress line with exactly2 sage segments filled from right. Footer quiet reset "התחלה מחדש" on left, restrained note "לאחר הבחירה יוצג הסבר לסיווג" on right. At bottom of page separate previous/next lesson controls "הקודם: לפני שמתחילים" right and orange "הבא: תבניות נוף" left. The main exercise should occupy y230 through900 approximately; balanced and highly visual, not a grid of repeated binary buttons. Only two category choice cards and exactly8 rail items. Before-answer state, no answers displayed for current house. No invented score, medals, stopwatch or leaderboard.

ALTERNATIVE B: "חוקרים את הנוף". This is visually and structurally DISTINCT from a photo-card quiz. A wide shared panoramic terrain investigation board with numbered HOTSPOTS; classification racks and immediate explained feedback. Intro exact "בחרו רכיב בנוף וסווגו אותו כתבליט או כתכסית." The white rounded workspace fills main width1052. At top right bold "מזהים. מסווגים. מבינים.", top left compact progress "סווגו 7 מתוך 8". Panorama takes FULLWIDTH approx1000x370, professional realistic 3D miniature LANDSCAPE, camera elevated oblique perspective, continuous grounded terrain, not square floating cuboid and not map with fake contours. Eight distinct spatial targets: 1 rounded bare hill, 2 irregular natural grove, 3 small house, 4 valley low area between hills, 5 paved road, 6 sloping bare hillside, 7 CULTIVATED OLIVE ORCHARD in very clear regular rows foreground, 8 saddle low ridge between two summits at far back. Correct landform geomorphology. Small calm numbered white circular markers on exact corresponding target with hairline leaders; all markers completed have small sage check, marker7 orange active focus ring, marker8 neutral tan as remaining item. Marker7 orchard has a thin orange outline encircling its rectangular cultivated patch and floating WHITE callout "מטע זיתים". Do not draw orange routes or glowing targeting reticles. This landscape is an educational illustrative image, not a cartographic navigation map.
BELOW panorama, two SIDE-BY-SIDE roomy classification receptacles inspired by archive's category bins: on RIGHT "תבליט", with subtle bare-hills vignette in header, and settled neutral thumbnail chips "גבעה", "עמק", "מדרון". On LEFT "תכסית", with grove/house vignette header, settled chips "חורש", "בית", "כביש", and orange focused chip "מטע זיתים". Three chips on relief, FOUR chips on cover, total exactly7. Small explicit completion check icons on settled chips; no rainbow. Category bins white with tan border, selected cover bin has restrained sage outline because correct answer has just been checked. Selected orchard chip represents current item already placed correctly. A tiny secondary text above bins "לחצו על קטגוריה או גררו אליה את הרכיב". Preserve keyboard/click alternative in visual wording, drag is optional.
Below bins fullwidth sage-tinted feedback band, modest check icon then exact black heading "נכון — מטע זיתים הוא תכסית", text "המטע ניטע בידי אדם על פני הקרקע, ולכן הוא תכסית מלאכותית." Prominent orange button on LEFT of this band "לרכיב הבא"; the final unclassified item is saddle. Bottom white workspace quiet action "התחלה מחדש". Exactly7/8 classified, not completed yet. Short bottom remaining hint "נותר רכיב אחד לסיווג". Palette, header and sidebar same site. No separate giant house photo card, no 8 card rail as in alternativeA, no invented scores, medals or time pressure. Make this feel like visually exploring a place and sorting what is found, not reading words. Crisp high quality completely implementable web UI.
